_comment: Azorius control piloted against Boros aggro -- the non-mirror form of arm 7. The Azorius MIRROR is not runnable: measured 16.7 decisions per turn against Boros's 8.9, needing 25+ turns to resolve, which exceeds the 40,960-token context budget in append-only rendering. A 2-game smoke aborted at turn 7 with BadRequestError. Against Boros the game ends by turn 9-12, the same regime arm 6 was collected in, so the trajectory fits.
